newsitem.title: CHINA: Guoco Land changes fiscal year end date.
newsitem.headline: Guoco Land changes fiscal year end date.

text.p: Guoco Land Ltd said on Friday it has changed its financial year end date to June 30 from March 31 with immediate effect.

"The purpose of the change is to provide for co-terminous accounting years throughout the Guoco Group of companies, as such consistency facilitates the preparation of the group consolidated accounts," Guoco land said in a statement.
The company said the next set of audited financial statements will be for the 15 months from April 1, 1997 to June 30, 1998.
